cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. What time did the kitchen light go off after the extra dinner plate was used?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why don't you ask who came over?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'd like to understand the timetable first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then which bus carried the timetable's missing person home?
